symbols.name: precision
symbols.meaning: The number of bits kept after each rounding of a computed value, which is of order lg n.
symbols.quote: The computed values keep $p$ bits after each rounding, the precision, which is of order $\lg n$.

relations.quote: It runs on one [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md).
It achieves a [Power saving in the logarithmic factor](power-saving.md), so its time is smaller than $n\log n$ by a power of $\lg n$.
It reduces multiplication to convolution through [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md).

relations.predicate: places its coefficients on axes by
relations.quote: It places its coefficients on axes by the [Chinese-remainder axis map](crt-axis-map.md), which preserves the convolution.
It rewrites its prime-length transforms by [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md).
It reduces the middle transform by [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein.md) to cyclic convolution.
It computes its transforms by a [Synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) over the ring $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$.
Each transform is built from simultaneous layers of [Simultaneous butterfly layer H₀](butterfly-layer.md) on polynomial records.
It packs signed coefficients by [Signed coefficient packing](signed-packing.md), so that polynomial products become integer products.
It calls the [Established fast multiplier](multiplier-subroutine.md) as a black box on shorter integers.

relations.predicate: recovers the exact binary product by
relations.quote: It recovers the exact binary product by [Exact recovery by rounding and carries](exact-recovery.md), since the coefficient error is below $1/2$.

relations.predicate: carries out its address rearrangements by
relations.quote: It carries out its address rearrangements by [Fast interchange of address chunks](tape-interchange.md).
